skills.name: Cloudlancer Art: North Wind
skills.desc: Deals Wind DMG equal to #1[i]% of Dan Heng's ATK to one enemy.

skills.name: Cloudlancer Art: Torrent
skills.desc:
Deals Wind DMG equal to #1[i]% of Dan Heng's ATK to one designated enemy.
When DMG dealt by Skill triggers CRIT Hit, there is a #4[i]% base chance to reduce the target's SPD by #2[i]%, lasting for #3[i] turn(s).

skills.name: Ethereal Dream
skills.desc: Deals Wind DMG equal to #1[i]% of Dan Heng's ATK to one designated enemy target. If the attacked enemy is Slowed, the multiplier for the DMG dealt by Ultimate increases by #2[i]%.

skills.name: Superiority of Reach
skills.desc: When Dan Heng becomes the target of an ally's ability, his next attack's Wind RES PEN increases by #1[i]%. This effect can be triggered again after #2[i] turn(s).

skills.name: Splitting Spearhead
skills.desc: After Dan Heng uses his Technique, his ATK increases by #1[i]% at the start of the next battle for #2[i] turn(s).

passives.name: Hidden Dragon
passives.desc: When current HP percentage is 50% or lower, reduces the chance of being attacked by enemies.

passives.name: Faster Than Light
passives.desc: After launching an attack, there is a 50% fixed chance to increase this unit's SPD by 20% for 2 turn(s).

passives.name: High Gale
